status: supplementary benchmark specified after price processing but before viewing any credit-return results
reason: The frozen 10-session exclusion buffer around monthly credit reports leaves zero ordinary-date controls for both COF triggers. The incomplete sponsor tag calendar also misses some actual AXP monthly reports.
comparison: Compare with up to five nearest non-trigger monthly credit-report filings for the same issuer and calendar year, requiring comparable unflagged portfolios. These are disclosure-day controls, NOT ordinary days.
selection: Absolute calendar-date distance, deterministic, no return information; remove qualifying triggers and reports within 30 days of a trigger to reduce event overlap.
claim: Supplementary descriptive comparison only. Does not replace or repair the missing frozen ordinary-day benchmark. No multiplicity-adjusted or out-of-sample alpha claim.
